<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=utf8><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><style>:root{color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}body{margin:0;padding:0;font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;background:#fff;color:#000}img{max-width:100%}[hidden]:not([hidden=until-found i]){display:none!important}</style></head><body>
<title>Number Line Hop</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka:wght@500;600;700&family=Nunito:wght@600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* Layout: sticker-book meadow. Chunky ink-outlined panels on a sky wash, one play column (max 920px) where the number line is the stage. */
:root {
--bg-top: #bfe8ff;
--bg-bottom: #f1fbff;
--surface: #ffffff;
--surface-2: #eef6fc;
--text: #1d2b4f;
--text-soft: #52628a;
--edge: #1d2b4f;
--shadow: #1d2b4f;
--accent: #ff7a45;
--accent-ink: #1d2b4f;
--accent-text: #c9481a;
--right: #138a52;
--left: #3f55d6;
--t1: #ff9fcf;
--t2: #ffe066;
--hl-ink: #1d2b4f;
--good: #138a52;
--bad: #d93b40;
--axis: #1d2b4f;
--tick-label: #3d4c72;
--cloud: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
--veil: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84);
--veil-strong: rgba(29, 43, 79, 0.55);
/* character art: same in both themes */
--char-line: #1d2b4f;
--fur: #ffffff;
--fur-pink: #ffb3cf;
--belly: #fff1f6;
--skin: #74d36b;
--skin-light: #d4f5b2;
--blush: #ff8fbd;
--mouth: #b3264f;
--tongue: #ff6f91;
--char-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16);
--display: "Fredoka", "Baloo 2", "Trebuchet MS", system-ui, sans-serif;
--body: "Nunito", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
--bg-top: #0d1433;
--bg-bottom: #1c2858;
--surface: #1f2a58;
--surface-2: #172150;
--text: #f0f4ff;
--text-soft: #a9b6dc;
--edge: #060a1c;
--shadow: #060a1c;
--accent: #ff8a5c;
--accent-ink: #1d2b4f;
--accent-text: #ffab86;
--right: #3ddc91;
--left: #8a9dff;
--good: #3ddc91;
--bad: #ff6b70;
--axis: #dfe6ff;
--tick-label: #b8c4ea;
--cloud: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
--veil: rgba(23, 33, 80, 0.86);
--veil-strong: rgba(4, 7, 22, 0.7);
color-scheme: dark;
}
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
--bg-top: #0d1433;
--bg-bottom: #1c2858;
--surface: #1f2a58;
--surface-2: #172150;
--text: #f0f4ff;
--text-soft: #a9b6dc;
--edge: #060a1c;
--shadow: #060a1c;
--accent: #ff8a5c;
--accent-ink: #1d2b4f;
--accent-text: #ffab86;
--right: #3ddc91;
--left: #8a9dff;
--good: #3ddc91;
--bad: #ff6b70;
--axis: #dfe6ff;
--tick-label: #b8c4ea;
--cloud: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
--veil: rgba(23, 33, 80, 0.86);
--veil-strong: rgba(4, 7, 22, 0.7);
color-scheme: dark;
}
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
html, body { min-height: 100%; }
body {
margin: 0;
background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-top), var(--bg-bottom)) fixed;
background-color: var(--bg-bottom);
color: var(--text);
font-family: var(--body);
font-weight: 600;
font-size: 16px;
padding-inline: 16px;
padding-block: 16px 48px;
overflow-x: hidden;
-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
-webkit-user-select: none;
user-select: none;
}
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--left); outline-offset: 3px; }
/* Drifting clouds */
.sky { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.cloud {
position: absolute; left: 0; width: 150px; height: 46px;
background: var(--cloud); border-radius: 999px;
animation: drift 80s linear infinite;
}
.cloud::before, .cloud::after { content: ""; position: absolute; background: inherit; border-radius: 50%; }
.cloud::before { width: 66px; height: 66px; left: 24px; top: -32px; }
.cloud::after { width: 50px; height: 50px; left: 76px; top: -22px; }
.cloud:nth-child(1) { top: 9%; animation-delay: -10s; }
.cloud:nth-child(2) { top: 38%; animation-duration: 110s; animation-delay: -70s; transform: scale(.7); }
.cloud:nth-child(3) { top: 70%; animation-duration: 95s; animation-delay: -40s; }
@keyframes drift { from { transform: translateX(-220px); } to { transform: translateX(calc(100vw + 220px)); } }
.app { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 920px; margin-inline: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.screen { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.card {
background: var(--surface);
border: 2.5px solid var(--edge);
border-radius: 22px;
box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--shadow);
padding: 16px;
min-width: 0;
}
.eyebrow {
font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 600; font-size: .78rem;
letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-soft);
}
.btn {
display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem;
padding: .55em 1.1em; min-height: 44px;
background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text);
border: 2.5px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 14px;
box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--shadow);
cursor: pointer; transition: transform .08s, box-shadow .08s, background-color .2s;
}
.btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; }
.btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }
.btn:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--shadow); }
.btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; transform: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--shadow); }
.btn-accent { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.btn-small { font-size: .95rem; min-height: 40px; padding: .4em .9em; }
.icon-btn {
width: 44px; height: 44px; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center;
border: 2.5px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface-2);
box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--shadow); cursor: pointer; color: var(--text); padding: 0;
}
.icon-btn:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--shadow); }
.icon-btn svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
/* ---------- Top bar ---------- */
.topbar {
display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr) auto auto;
align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px;
}
.tb-title strong { display: block; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.tb-progress { min-width: 0; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--text-soft); }
.bar { height: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-2); overflow: hidden; margin-top: 4px; }
.bar i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 10%; background: var(--accent); border-right: 2px solid var(--edge); transition: width .45s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.4, .5, 1); }
.tb-count {
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 12px 3px 6px;
font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
background: var(--surface-2); border: 2px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 999px;
}
.tb-count svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: block; }
.bump { display: inline-block; animation: bump .45s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.8, .4, 1); }
@keyframes bump { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 40% { transform: scale(1.6); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
.topbar { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; }
.tb-progress { grid-column: 1 / -1; order: 5; }
}
/* ---------- Home ---------- */
.home-hero { position: relative; text-align: center; padding: 22px 16px 16px; }
.home-hero h1 {
font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; margin: 0; line-height: 1;
font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 9vw, 4.2rem); letter-spacing: -.01em; text-wrap: balance;
}
.home-hero h1 .hop { display: inline-block; color: var(--accent); text-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--edge); animation: titleHop 2.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes titleHop { 0%, 70%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0); } 80% { transform: translateY(-12px) rotate(-5deg); } 90% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(2deg); } }
.home-sub { margin: .6rem 0 0; color: var(--text-soft); font-size: 1.05rem; text-wrap: balance; }
.home-sound { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; }
.hero-svg { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 560px; height: auto; margin: 6px auto 0; overflow: visible; }
.hero-caption { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--text-soft); }
.hero-caption b { color: var(--right); }
.hero-caption b.neg { color: var(--left); }
.levels { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
@media (max-width: 660px) { .levels { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.level-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 18px; }
.level-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.level-badge {
width: 54px; height: 54px; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center;
font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.7rem; color: var(--hl-ink);
border: 2.5px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--shadow);
}
.level-card:nth-child(1) .level-badge { background: var(--t2); transform: rotate(-4deg); }
.level-card:nth-child(2) .level-badge { background: var(--t1); transform: rotate(4deg); }
.level-card h2 { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.4rem; line-height: 1.1; margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; }
.level-card p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text-soft); max-width: 60ch; }
.chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.chip { font-size: .8rem; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--edge); background: var(--surface-2); }
.level-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: auto; }
.best { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--text-soft); }
.best svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
.star-on path { fill: var(--t2); stroke: var(--edge); }
.star-off path { fill: var(--surface-2); stroke: var(--text-soft); }
.teacher-note { text-align: center; color: var(--text-soft); font-size: .9rem; margin: 2px 0 0; line-height: 1.5; text-wrap: balance; }
.levels { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
@media (max-width: 820px) { .levels { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
@media (max-width: 560px) { .levels { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.level-card:nth-child(3) .level-badge { background: #a9e7ff; transform: rotate(-3deg); }
/* ---------- Level 3 battle ---------- */
.l3-mode { text-align: center; padding: clamp(18px, 4vw, 34px); }
.l3-mode h2, .l3-end h2 { font-family: var(--display); font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 5vw, 2.2rem); margin: 0; }
.l3-mode p { color: var(--text-soft); margin: 6px 0 18px; }
.l3-mode-buttons { display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; }
.l3-question { text-align: center; padding: 12px 18px; }
.l3-question .equation { padding: 0; margin: 2px 0; }
.l3-status { margin: 0; min-height: 1.5em; color: var(--text-soft); font-weight: 800; }
.battle-arena { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--surface), var(--surface-2)); }
.battle-fighter { min-width: 0; text-align: center; padding: 12px 10px; border: 2px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--shadow); }
.battle-fighter h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.1rem; }
.battle-role { color: var(--text-soft); font-size: .78rem; }
.battle-avatar { display: block; width: clamp(68px, 12vw, 96px); height: 100px; margin: 4px auto 0; overflow: visible; }
#l3-char-2 { transform: scaleX(-1); }
.battle-hearts { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; color: #e84163; font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1; }
.battle-hearts .spent { opacity: .22; }
.battle-vs { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 3px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--t2); color: var(--hl-ink); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--shadow); }
.battle-fighter.attack-right { animation: attackRight .42s cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .3, 1); }
.battle-fighter.attack-left { animation: attackLeft .42s cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .3, 1); }
.battle-fighter.got-hit { animation: gotHit .42s ease-in-out; }
@keyframes attackRight { 45% { transform: translateX(28px) scale(1.08); } 100% { transform: none; } }
@keyframes attackLeft { 45% { transform: translateX(-28px) scale(1.08); } 100% { transform: none; } }
@keyframes gotHit { 20%, 60% { transform: translateX(-8px) rotate(-3deg); filter: saturate(.4); } 40%, 80% { transform: translateX(8px) rotate(3deg); } }
.battle-impact { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 42%; z-index: 2; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0); font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 9vw, 4.5rem); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.battle-impact.show { animation: impactPop .55s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.7, .4, 1); }
@keyframes impactPop { 20% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.2) rotate(-10deg); } 75% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1) rotate(8deg); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(.4); } }
.battle-pads { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
.battle-pad { padding: 12px; }
.battle-pad-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.battle-pad-head strong { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.05rem; }
.battle-answer-box { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; margin-bottom: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--accent-text); font: 700 1.8rem var(--display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.battle-keys { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }
.battle-keys .key { min-height: 43px; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.battle-keys .key-small { font-size: .78rem; }
.battle-keys .key-check { grid-column: span 2; }
.battle-keys .key-zero { grid-column: span 2; }
.computer-card { min-height: 150px; display: grid; place-items: center; text-align: center; line-height: 1.45; }
.computer-card .computer-icon { font-size: 2rem; }
.l3-end { text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.l3-end p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-soft); }
.l3-end-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; }
@media (max-width: 640px) { .battle-pads { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
@media (max-width: 420px) {
.battle-arena { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 38px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 6px; padding: 8px; }
.battle-fighter { padding: 8px 4px; }
.battle-avatar { width: 64px; height: 82px; }
.battle-vs { width: 38px; height: 38px; }
}
/* ---------- Prompt card + speech bubble ---------- */
.prompt { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 12px 18px; align-items: center; overflow: hidden; }
.buddy { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
.avatar { width: clamp(66px, 12vw, 92px); height: auto; flex: none; overflow: visible; }
.bubble {
position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 0; margin: 0 0 0 14px;
background: var(--surface-2); border: 2.5px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 18px;
padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 700;
transform-origin: left center;
}
.bubble::before, .bubble::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); border-style: solid; border-color: transparent; }
.bubble::before { left: -14px; border-width: 10px 14px 10px 0; border-right-color: var(--edge); }
.bubble::after { left: -9.5px; border-width: 7.5px 10px 7.5px 0; border-right-color: var(--surface-2); }
.bubble b { color: var(--accent-text); }
.bubble.pop { animation: pop .32s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.6, .4, 1); }
@keyframes pop { from { transform: scale(.9); } to { transform: scale(1); } }
.tagtxt { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 600; font-style: normal; color: var(--hl-ink); padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--edge); line-height: 1.35; }
.tagtxt.t1 { background: var(--t1); }
.tagtxt.t2 { background: var(--t2); }
.target-box, .problem {
display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0;
padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface-2); border: 2.5px dashed var(--edge);
}
.target-box { min-width: 10.5rem; }
.target-num { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(3rem, 10vw, 4.6rem); line-height: 1; color: var(--accent-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.hint-text { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 0; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--t2); color: var(--hl-ink); border: 2px solid var(--edge); line-height: 1.5; }
.btn-hint[aria-pressed="true"], .btn-hl[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--t2); color: var(--hl-ink); }
.stamp {
position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; z-index: 3; pointer-events: none;
font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 5vw, 2.4rem);
padding: .15em .6em; border: 4px solid currentColor; border-radius: 14px;
background: var(--surface); color: var(--good); opacity: 0;
transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-9deg) scale(0);
}
.stamp.bad { color: var(--bad); }
.stamp.show { animation: stamp .38s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.6, .4, 1) forwards; }
@keyframes stamp {
from { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-9deg) scale(2.3); }
to { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-9deg) scale(1); }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
.prompt { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
.target-box, .problem { order: -1; }
}
/* ---------- Number line stage ---------- */
.stage { padding: 12px; transition: background-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; }
.stage.drag-over { border-style: dashed; }
.stage.drag-hot { background: var(--surface-2); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--shadow), 0 0 0 5px var(--t2); }
.stage-top, .stage-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.stage-top { margin-bottom: 4px; }
.stage-foot { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--text-soft); font-size: .88rem; }
.drop-chip { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 500; font-size: .9rem; padding: 3px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-2); border: 2px dashed var(--edge); }
.lane-key { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--text-soft); display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.scroller { overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; touch-action: pan-x; scrollbar-width: thin; }
.scroller svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; overflow: hidden; }
#l1-svg { min-width: 600px; }
#l2-svg { min-width: 720px; }
.axis { stroke: var(--axis); stroke-width: 3.5; stroke-linecap: round; }
.axis-head { fill: var(--axis); }
.tick { stroke: var(--axis); stroke-width: 2; }
.tick.major { stroke-width: 2.6; }
.tick.zero { stroke-width: 4; }
.tick-label { fill: var(--tick-label); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; text-anchor: middle; }
.tick-label.major { fill: var(--text); font-weight: 600; }
.tick-label.zero { fill: var(--text); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; }
.tick-label.hot { fill: var(--accent-text); font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; }
#l2-svg .tick-label { font-size: 12px; }
#l2-svg .tick-label.major { font-size: 13px; }
.vec-shape { stroke: var(--edge); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.vec-pos .vec-shape, .vec-pos .vec-dot { fill: var(--right); }
.vec-neg .vec-shape, .vec-neg .vec-dot { fill: var(--left); }
.vec-divider { stroke: var(--surface); stroke-width: 1.6; opacity: .8; }
.vec-guide { fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 4 4; }
.vec-pos .vec-guide { stroke: var(--right); }
.vec-neg .vec-guide { stroke: var(--left); }
.vec-guide.faint { opacity: .55; }
.ring { fill: none; stroke-width: 3; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: ringPulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.ring.hint { stroke: var(--accent); }
.ring.land { stroke: var(--good); }
.ring.answer { stroke: var(--accent); stroke-dasharray: 5 4; }
.ring-dot.hint, .ring-dot.answer { fill: var(--accent); }
.ring-dot.land { fill: var(--good); }
@keyframes ringPulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } 50% { transform: scale(1.22); opacity: .6; } }
.count-pop { fill: var(--accent-text); font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; text-anchor: middle; animation: floatUp .75s ease-out forwards; }
@keyframes floatUp { from { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } to { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-22px); } }
.dust { fill: var(--text-soft); opacity: .55; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: puff .5s ease-out forwards; }
@keyframes puff { to { transform: scale(2.6); opacity: 0; } }
.lane-tag rect { stroke: var(--edge); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.lane-tag.t1 rect { fill: var(--t1); }
.lane-tag.t2 rect { fill: var(--t2); }
.lane-tag text { fill: var(--hl-ink); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-anchor: middle; }
.tongue { stroke: var(--tongue); stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; }
.c2-tongue { stroke-width: 6; }
.fly .wing { fill: rgba(200, 230, 255, .9); stroke: var(--char-line); stroke-width: .8; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 100%; animation: flap .07s linear infinite alternate; }
.fly .fly-body { fill: #2b2f45; stroke: var(--char-line); stroke-width: .8; }
.fly .fly-eye { fill: #e5484d; }
@keyframes flap { from { transform: scaleY(1); } to { transform: scaleY(.35); } }
/* ---------- Arrow cards ---------- */
.options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
@media (max-width: 640px) { .options { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.opt-card, .l2-card {
display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
min-height: 92px; padding: 12px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text);
border: 2.5px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--shadow);
cursor: grab; touch-action: none; transition: transform .15s, opacity .2s, filter .2s;
}
.opt-card:hover, .l2-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-.8deg); }
.opt-card.lifted, .l2-card.lifted { opacity: .4; transform: scale(.97); }
.opt-card.chosen { box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--shadow), 0 0 0 5px var(--t2); }
.opt-card svg { display: block; overflow: visible; }
.opt-label { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.vec-pos .opt-label { color: var(--right); }
.vec-neg .opt-label { color: var(--left); }
.panel-title { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.panel-title span:last-child { font-size: .88rem; color: var(--text-soft); }
.l2-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
@media (max-width: 720px) { .l2-cards { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
.l2-card { padding: 10px 8px; gap: 6px; }
.l2-card .card-arrow { width: 100%; max-width: 132px; height: auto; overflow: visible; }
.l2-card.dim { opacity: .38; filter: saturate(.5); }
.tag { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 600; font-size: .8rem; padding: 1px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--edge); color: var(--hl-ink); }
.tag.t1 { background: var(--t1); }
.tag.t2 { background: var(--t2); }
.hl-on .l2-card .tag { animation: tagGlow 1.1s ease-in-out 2; }
@keyframes tagGlow { 50% { transform: scale(1.18); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--surface-2); } }
.wiggle { animation: wiggle .45s; }
@keyframes wiggle { 20% { transform: rotate(-5deg); } 40% { transform: rotate(5deg); } 60% { transform: rotate(-3deg); } 80% { transform: rotate(2deg); } }
.drag-ghost { position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 90; pointer-events: none; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-3deg); filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3)); }
div.drag-ghost { width: 150px; }
/* ---------- Level 2 equation ---------- */
.equation {
font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 7.5vw, 3.4rem);
line-height: 1.15; white-space: nowrap; padding-bottom: 1.15rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.term {
position: relative; display: inline-block; padding: 0 .14em; border-radius: .2em;
background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: left center; background-size: 0% 100%;
transition: background-size .45s ease, color .2s;
}
.term.t1 { background-image: linear-gradient(var(--t1), var(--t1)); }
.term.t2 { background-image: linear-gradient(var(--t2), var(--t2)); transition-delay: .18s; }
.equation.hl .term { background-size: 100% 100%; color: var(--hl-ink); }
.implied { display: inline-block; max-width: 0; opacity: 0; overflow: hidden; vertical-align: bottom; transition: max-width .3s, opacity .3s; }
.equation.hl .implied { max-width: .7em; opacity: .55; }
.term-tag {
position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 100%; transform: translate(-50%, 3px);
font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; white-space: nowrap;
padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--edge); color: var(--hl-ink);
opacity: 0; transition: opacity .3s .35s;
}
.t1 .term-tag { background: var(--t1); }
.t2 .term-tag { background: var(--t2); }
.equation.hl .term-tag { opacity: 1; }
.eq-rest { color: var(--text-soft); }
.steps { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.steps li {
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 4px 12px 4px 4px;
border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--edge); background: var(--surface-2);
font-size: .9rem; color: var(--text-soft); transition: background-color .2s, color .2s;
}
.steps .n { width: 24px; height: 24px; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--edge); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font-family: var(--display); font-size: .85rem; }
.steps li.active { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); animation: nudge 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
.steps li.done { color: var(--text); }
.steps li.done .n { background: var(--good); color: var(--surface); }
@keyframes nudge { 0%, 80%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 90% { transform: translateY(-3px); } }
/* ---------- Keypad ---------- */
.keypad { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr); gap: 14px; align-items: center; }
@media (max-width: 720px) { .keypad { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.answer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.answer-box {
display: block; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 2.2rem; text-align: center;
padding: 4px 10px; min-height: 3.4rem; color: var(--accent-text);
border: 2.5px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.keys { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .keys { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .key-check { grid-column: span 2; } }
.key {
min-height: 50px; padding: 0; border: 2.5px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 14px;
background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--shadow);
font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;
}
.key:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--shadow); }
.key-small { font-size: .9rem; }
.key-check { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; }
.lock {
position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 2; border-radius: 20px; padding: 12px;
display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; text-align: center;
background: var(--veil); font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem;
}
.lock svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; flex: none; }
/* ---------- Characters ---------- */
.char .shadow { fill: var(--char-shadow); }
.char .fur { fill: var(--fur); stroke: var(--char-line); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.char .pink { fill: var(--fur-pink); }
.char .belly { fill: var(--belly); }
.char .skin { fill: var(--skin); stroke: var(--char-line); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.char .skin-light { fill: var(--skin-light); }
.char .eye-white { fill: #ffffff; stroke: var(--char-line); stroke-width: 1.2; }
.char .pupil { fill: var(--char-line); }
.char .shine { fill: #ffffff; }
.char .blush { fill: var(--blush); opacity: .75; }
.char .nose { fill: #ff6f9e; }
.char .line { fill: none; stroke: var(--char-line); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.char .mouth-open { fill: var(--mouth); stroke: var(--char-line); stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.char .mouth-open .tongue-fill { fill: var(--tongue); stroke: none; }
.char .eye-happy, .char .eye-dizzy, .char .mouth-open, .char .mouth-sad { display: none; }
.char.mood-happy .eye-normal, .char.mood-happy .mouth-smile,
.char.mood-sad .eye-normal, .char.mood-sad .mouth-smile { display: none; }
.char.mood-happy .eye-happy, .char.mood-happy .mouth-open,
.char.mood-sad .eye-dizzy, .char.mood-sad .mouth-sad { display: inline; }
.char .bob { animation: bob 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
@keyframes bob { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1, 1); } 50% { transform: translateY(-1.2px) scale(1.02, .98); } }
.char .eye-normal { animation: blink 4.4s infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
@keyframes blink { 0%, 93%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); } 95.5% { transform: scaleY(.1); } }
.char-bunny .ear-l, .char-bunny .ear-r { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
.char-bunny .ear-l { animation: earL 3.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.char-bunny .ear-r { animation: earR 3.6s ease-in-out infinite .25s; }
@keyframes earL { 0%, 70%, 100% { transform: rotate(0); } 80% { transform: rotate(-14deg); } 90% { transform: rotate(4deg); } }
@keyframes earR { 0%, 70%, 100% { transform: rotate(0); } 80% { transform: rotate(14deg); } 90% { transform: rotate(-4deg); } }
.char.mood-happy .bob { animation: cheer .55s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes cheer { 0%, 50%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0); } 25% { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-6deg); } 75% { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(6deg); } }
.char.mood-sad .bob { animation: dizzy .6s ease-in-out 3; }
@keyframes dizzy { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0); } 25% { transform: rotate(-9deg); } 75% { transform: rotate(9deg); } }
/* ---------- Modal, toast, effects ---------- */
.modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 16px; background: var(--veil-strong); }
.modal-card { width: min(480px, 100%); max-height: calc(100vh - 32px); overflow: auto; text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; animation: rise .45s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.4, .4, 1); }
@keyframes rise { from { transform: translateY(40px) scale(.9); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
.modal-card h2 { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 2rem; margin: 0; }
.modal-card .avatar { width: 110px; }
.stars { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.stars svg { width: 50px; height: 50px; }
.stars .star-on { animation: starPop .5s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.7, .4, 1) backwards; }
@keyframes starPop { from { transform: scale(0) rotate(-40deg); } to { transform: scale(1) rotate(0); } }
.m-score { margin: 0; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.m-score b { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--accent-text); }
.m-grade { margin: 0; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.25rem; }
.review { width: 100%; max-height: 190px; overflow: auto; text-align: left; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface-2); font-size: .9rem; }
.review div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.review .ok { color: var(--good); font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; }
.review .no { color: var(--bad); font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; }
.m-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; justify-content: center; margin-top: 4px; }
.toast {
position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); z-index: 95;
max-width: calc(100% - 32px); padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 16px;
background: var(--text); color: var(--surface); font-weight: 700; text-align: center;
transform: translate(-50%, calc(100% + 40px)); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.4, .4, 1), opacity .2s;
}
.toast.show { transform: translate(-50%, 0); opacity: 1; }
.fx { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 98; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; }
.confetti { position: absolute; display: block; border: 1.5px solid var(--edge); }
.collect { position: absolute; width: 36px; height: 36px; margin: -18px 0 0 -18px; }
.collect svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
.char *, .cloud, .bubble, .steps li, .ring, .home-hero h1 .hop, .hl-on .l2-card .tag, .bar i, .battle-fighter, .battle-impact { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
.stamp.show { animation: none; opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-9deg) scale(1); }
}
/* ---------- Coordinate Plane Hop ---------- */
.game-section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; margin-top: 12px; }
.game-section-heading { text-align: center; }
.game-section-heading h2 { margin: 2px 0 4px; font-family: var(--display); font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 5vw, 2.2rem); }
.game-section-heading p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-soft); }
.coord-prompt { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 16px; }
.coord-prompt h2 { margin: 2px 0 4px; font-family: var(--display); font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 1.8rem); }
.coord-target { margin: 0; color: var(--accent-text); font: 700 clamp(2rem, 7vw, 3rem) var(--display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.coord-punctuation { color: #fff; }
.coord-x-value { color: var(--bad); }
.coord-y-value { color: var(--good); }
.coord-reward-counts { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.coord-reward-count { white-space: nowrap; }
.coord-reward-count b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.coord-status { margin: 4px 0 0; min-height: 1.5em; color: var(--text-soft); font-weight: 800; }
.coord-board { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
.coord-svg { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 560px; height: auto; touch-action: manipulation; }
.coord-svg .char { pointer-events: none; }
.coord-grid-line { stroke: var(--text-soft); stroke-width: 1; opacity: .24; }
.coord-axis-line { stroke: var(--axis); stroke-width: 3; }
.coord-grid-dot { fill: var(--text-soft); opacity: .5; }
.coord-label { fill: var(--tick-label); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 27px; font-weight: 700; text-anchor: middle; }
.coord-label.zero { fill: var(--text); font-size: 31.5px; font-weight: 800; }
.coord-axis-name { fill: var(--text); font: 700 22.5px var(--display); text-anchor: middle; }
.coord-guide-x { stroke: var(--bad); stroke-width: 3.5; stroke-dasharray: 2 5; stroke-linecap: round; opacity: .98; }
.coord-guide-y { stroke: var(--good); stroke-width: 3.5; stroke-dasharray: 2 5; stroke-linecap: round; opacity: .98; }
.coord-axis-hit { fill: transparent; stroke: transparent; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: all; }
.coord-axis-target-x { fill: var(--bad); fill-opacity: .2; stroke: var(--bad); stroke-width: 2; pointer-events: none; }
.coord-axis-target-y { fill: var(--good); fill-opacity: .22; stroke: var(--good); stroke-width: 2; pointer-events: none; }
.coord-axis-hint { stroke-width: 3.5; stroke-dasharray: 3 2; animation: coordHintPulse .8s ease-in-out 3; }
@keyframes coordHintPulse { 50% { fill-opacity: .48; stroke-width: 5; } }
.coord-axis-selected-x { fill: var(--bad); stroke: var(--edge); stroke-width: 2; }
.coord-axis-selected-y { fill: var(--good); stroke: var(--edge); stroke-width: 2; }
.coord-star { fill: var(--t2); stroke: var(--edge); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.coord-choice { fill: var(--t1); stroke: var(--edge); stroke-width: 2.5; }
.coord-cursor { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent-text); stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-dasharray: 3 2; pointer-events: none; }
.coord-answer-ring { fill: none; stroke: var(--bad); stroke-width: 3; stroke-dasharray: 5 3; }
.coord-entry { display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin: 4px 0 10px; }
.coord-field { min-width: 130px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 14px; background: var(--surface-2); border: 2px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--shadow); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--display); }
.coord-field.active { background: var(--t2); }
.coord-field strong { font-size: 1.1rem; }
.coord-field output { min-width: 2ch; color: var(--accent-text); font-size: 1.55rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.coord-instructions { margin: 0 0 10px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-soft); }
.coord-pad { max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto; }
.coord-pad .key { min-height: 43px; }
.coord-battle-fields { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin: 6px 0; }
.coord-battle-fields .coord-field { min-width: 0; flex: 1; padding: 6px 5px; gap: 4px; font-size: .9rem; }
.coord-battle-fields .coord-field output { font-size: 1.25rem; }
.coord-battle-fields + .coord-pad .key { min-height: 39px; }
.coord-end { text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.coord-end h2 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.8rem; }
.coord-end p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-soft); }
.coord-end-actions { display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.c2-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(225px, 300px); gap: 12px; align-items: stretch; }
.c2-layout .coord-board { min-width: 0; }
.c2-layout .coord-svg { max-width: 670px; }
.c2-controls { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 12px; }
.c2-controls .coord-entry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 7px; }
.c2-controls .coord-field { min-width: 0; padding: 8px 4px; }
.c2-controls .coord-hint-btn { width: 100%; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.c2-controls .coord-pad { width: 100%; max-width: none; }
.c1-svg { max-width: 670px; }
.c1-board { padding-top: 0; }
.coord-outcome-marker { font-size: 26px; text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: central; pointer-events: none; }
.c3-layout { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(180px, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(180px, 1fr); gap: 10px; align-items: start; }
.c3-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.c3-side .battle-pad { padding: 10px; }
.c3-side .battle-pad-head { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.c3-side .battle-pad-head .eyebrow { font-size: .68rem; }
.c3-side .coord-battle-fields { gap: 4px; margin: 4px 0 6px; }
.c3-side .coord-battle-fields .coord-field { padding: 5px 3px; }
.c3-side .coord-battle-fields + .coord-pad .key { min-height: 36px; }
.c3-board { min-width: 0; }
.c3-board .coord-svg { max-width: 560px; }
.c3-layout .battle-fighter { padding: 10px 6px; }
#screen-c3 .c3-layout .battle-avatar { width: 100%; max-width: 98px; height: 96px; }
#c3-char-2 { transform: scaleX(-1); }
@media (max-width: 720px) {
.c2-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(205px, 245px); gap: 8px; }

}

}
@media (max-width: 560px) {

.c2-controls { min-height: 300px; }
.c3-layout { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); align-items: start; }
.c3-board { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 1; }
.c3-side-1 { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
.c3-side-2 { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; }
}

<!-- ================= HOME ================= -->
<section class="screen" id="screen-home">
<div class="card home-hero">
<button class="icon-btn home-sound" type="button" data-sound></button>
<h1>Number Line <span class="hop">Hop</span></h1>
<p class="home-sub">Directed numbers and straight vectors with Pip the bunny and Freddie the frog</p>
<svg class="hero-svg" id="hero-svg" viewBox="-205 -82 410 136" role="img" aria-label="A number line from −5 to +5. Pip the bunny stands at −3 on a blue arrow pointing left. Freddie the frog stands at +3 on a green arrow pointing right."></svg>
<p class="hero-caption"><b>+3</b> means 3 units to the right of 0. <b class="neg">−3</b> means 3 units to the left.</p>
</div>
<div class="levels">
<article class="card level-card">
<div class="level-head"><span class="level-badge">1</span><h2>Pip's Arrow Hop</h2></div>
<p>Match each directed number with its vector. Drag the arrow that starts at 0 and ends on the target, and Pip hops along it one unit at a time.</p>
<div class="chips"><span class="chip">Directed numbers</span><span class="chip">Positive and negative</span><span class="chip">Vectors</span></div>
<div class="level-foot"><span class="best" id="best-1"></span><button class="btn btn-accent" type="button" data-start="1">Play Level 1</button></div>
</article>
<article class="card level-card">
<div class="level-head"><span class="level-badge">2</span><h2>Freddie's Double Jump</h2></div>
<p>Add and subtract directed numbers by joining two vectors head to tail. Use the highlighter to see where each term begins and ends.</p>
<div class="chips"><span class="chip">Addition</span><span class="chip">Subtraction</span><span class="chip">Terms</span></div>
<div class="level-foot"><span class="best" id="best-2"></span><button class="btn btn-accent" type="button" data-start="2">Play Level 2</button></div>
</article>
<article class="card level-card">
<div class="level-head"><span class="level-badge">3</span><h2>Number Line Battle</h2></div>
<p>Race to solve Level 2 style questions. Correct answers let Pip or Freddie strike and take a heart.</p>
<div class="chips"><span class="chip">Player vs computer</span><span class="chip">Player vs player</span><span class="chip">3 hearts each</span></div>
<div class="level-foot"><span class="best">Fast answers win the round!</span><button class="btn btn-accent" type="button" data-start="3">Play Level 3</button></div>
</article>
</div>
<p class="teacher-note">For P.4 to P.6 · Levels 1–2 practise vectors · Level 3 is a quick one-player or two-player battle</p>
<section class="game-section" aria-labelledby="coordinate-game-title">
<div class="game-section-heading">
<span class="eyebrow">A new adventure</span>
<h2 id="coordinate-game-title">Coordinate Plane Hop</h2>
<p>Help Pip and Freddie explore the rectangular coordinate system.</p>
</div>
<div class="levels">
<article class="card level-card">
<div class="level-head"><span class="level-badge">1</span><h2>Pip's Point Hop</h2></div>
<p>Tap the red x-axis value, then the green y-axis value, and choose their meeting point. Pip starts beside the grid and jumps to your choice for a carrot or a trap.</p>
<div class="chips"><span class="chip">−4 to 4</span><span class="chip">Ordered pairs</span><span class="chip">8 rounds</span></div>
<div class="level-foot"><span class="best">Locate the point!</span><button class="btn btn-accent" type="button" data-cstart="1">Play Level 1</button></div>
</article>
<article class="card level-card">
<div class="level-head"><span class="level-badge">2</span><h2>Freddie's Fly Hunt</h2></div>
<p>Read the fly's location and enter its x and y coordinates. Freddie waits beside the grid and licks it with his tongue.</p>
<div class="chips"><span class="chip">−4 to 4</span><span class="chip">Number pad</span><span class="chip">8 rounds</span></div>
<div class="level-foot"><span class="best">Find the fly!</span><button class="btn btn-accent" type="button" data-cstart="2">Play Level 2</button></div>
</article>
<article class="card level-card">
<div class="level-head"><span class="level-badge">3</span><h2>Coordinate Battle</h2></div>
<p>Race to name the star's coordinates. Pip and Freddie battle against the computer or challenge a friend.</p>
<div class="chips"><span class="chip">−4 to 4</span><span class="chip">Player vs computer</span><span class="chip">Player vs player</span><span class="chip">3 hearts each</span></div>
<div class="level-foot"><span class="best">Fast, accurate answers win!</span><button class="btn btn-accent" type="button" data-cstart="3">Play Level 3</button></div>
</article>
</div>
</section>
